name: Leo Crawford
source:
With a flirtatious attitude to match his charisma, this playful bureaucrat carries himself about the palace as if borne atop a whimsical breeze. What is it, then, that will ever so rarely twist his jaunty smirk into piercing severity...?

[Taken from in-game description]
